words.urdu: خوشگوار تجربہ / آرام دہ
words.meaning: A situation of comfort and ease.

words.urdu: غیر معتبر شخص
words.meaning: An unreliable person or thing.

words.word: A chip of the old block.
words.urdu: جیسا باپ ویسا بیٹا
words.meaning: A child who is very much like his father.

words.urdu: بہت دیر سے
words.meaning: Too late to benefit from an opportunity.

words.urdu: اونٹ کے منہ میں زیرہ
words.meaning: A very small amount compared with what is needed.

words.urdu: اندھوں میں کانا راجا
words.meaning: Someone who stands out among ordinary people.

words.urdu: ارد گرد کے ماحول میں بے چینی
words.meaning: Someone uncomfortable in unfamiliar surroundings.

words.urdu: ایک چھوٹی سی چیز جو قیمتی شے کو خراب کر دیتی ہے
words.meaning: A small flaw that spoils something good.

words.urdu: اپنی صلاحیتوں کا غلط اندازہ لگانے والا
words.meaning: Someone who overestimates his own importance.

words.urdu: بے مقصد سفر
words.meaning: A pointless mission.

words.urdu: تاریخ کا روشن دور
words.meaning: A period of great achievement and peace.

words.urdu: لوہے کے چنے چبانا
words.meaning: A very difficult problem or person.

words.urdu: ایسی حالت جس میں کامیابی یا ناکامی دونوں ممکن ہوں
words.meaning: An uncertain outcome.

words.urdu: چار دن کی چاندنی پھر اندھیری رات
words.meaning: Something that attracts attention only briefly.

words.urdu: آستین کا سانپ
words.meaning: A hidden enemy or traitor.

words.word: A square peg in a round hole.
words.urdu: بے محل و بے موقع
words.meaning: Someone unsuited to his position.

words.urdu: بغل میں چھری منہ میں رام رام
words.meaning: A dangerous person who pretends to be harmless.

words.word: Between the devil and the deep sea.
words.urdu: آگے کنواں پیچھے کھائی
words.meaning: Stuck between two dangers or difficult choices.

words.word: By the skin of one's teeth.
words.urdu: بال بال
words.meaning: By a very narrow margin.

words.urdu: زبانی طور پر
words.meaning: Through spoken words rather than writing.

words.urdu: بھینس کے آگے بین بجانا
words.meaning: Wasting good things on people who cannot value them.

words.urdu: ایسی بات جو کچھ سوچنے کا موقع دے
words.meaning: Something worth thinking about.

words.urdu: کبھی کبھار
words.meaning: Occasionally, now and then.

words.urdu: انگور کھٹے ہیں
words.meaning: Pretending to dislike what you cannot get.

words.urdu: گہرے دوست
words.meaning: Very close and in full agreement.

words.urdu: نہایت آسانی سے
words.meaning: Easily and without doubt.

words.urdu: امیر و غریب
words.meaning: The rich and the poor.

words.urdu: اس کی عقل گھاس چرنے کو گئی ہے
words.meaning: He has gone mad or foolish.

words.word: His bark is worse than his bite.
words.urdu: اس کا بھونکنا کاٹنے سے بھی برا ہے
words.meaning: He sounds more frightening than he really is.

words.word: Hit the nail on the head.
words.urdu: مطلوبہ مقصد حاصل کرنا
words.meaning: To say or do exactly the right thing.

words.urdu: آہستہ آہستہ
words.meaning: Slowly and gradually.

words.word: Make the best of a bad bargain.
words.urdu: بھرپور فائدہ اٹھانا
words.meaning: Accept a bad situation and get the most from it.

words.urdu: آدھا تیتر آدھا بٹیر
words.meaning: Something that fits no clear category.

words.word: Out of the frying pan into the fire.
words.urdu: آسمان سے گرا کھجور میں اٹکا
words.meaning: Going from a bad situation to a worse one.

words.urdu: جلے پر نمک چھڑکنا
words.meaning: Making someone's pain or sorrow worse.

words.urdu: ادلے کا بدلہ
words.meaning: Returning equal treatment, harm for harm.

words.word: To be a puppet in someone's hands.
words.urdu: دوسرے کے ہاتھ کی کٹھ پتلی
words.meaning: To be controlled by another person.

words.urdu: وعدہ توڑنا
words.meaning: To fail to keep a promise.

words.urdu: آغاز کرنا
words.meaning: To start a conversation in an awkward situation.

words.urdu: غیر متوقع خبر دینا
words.meaning: To tell someone surprising or bad news.

words.urdu: مر جانا
words.meaning: To die.

words.urdu: ظاہر کرنا
words.meaning: To reveal something hidden.

words.urdu: اپنی عمارت کی بنیاد ریت پر رکھنا
words.meaning: To base something on an insecure foundation.

words.urdu: الٹے بانس بریلی کو
words.meaning: To do something completely unnecessary.

words.urdu: جھلک دیکھنا
words.meaning: To see something briefly.

words.urdu: بد قسمتی کا سامنا کرنا
words.meaning: To meet with disaster or failure.

words.urdu: لا حاصل
words.meaning: To end in failure.

words.word: To dig a well when the fire has started.
words.urdu: آگ لگنے پر کنواں کھودنا
words.meaning: To act too late.

words.urdu: لکیر کا فقیر
words.meaning: To follow tradition without thinking.

words.word: To give someone a piece of one's mind.
words.urdu: کھری کھری سنانا
words.meaning: To tell someone off frankly.

words.word: To have one foot in the grave.
words.urdu: موت کے قریب ہونا
words.meaning: To be very old or near death.

words.word: To have one's heart in one's mouth.
words.urdu: گھبرانا، خوف زدہ ہونا
words.meaning: To be very frightened.

words.word: To have other fish to fry.
words.urdu: کچھ اور بھی کرنے کو ہونا
words.meaning: To have more important things to do.

words.word: To have two strings to one's bow.
words.urdu: ایک سے زیادہ ذرائع رکھنا
words.meaning: To have a backup plan.

words.word: To make a mountain of a molehill.
words.urdu: بات کا بتنگڑ بنانا
words.meaning: To exaggerate a small problem.

words.word: To make a rope of sand.
words.urdu: مٹی کی رسی بنانا
words.meaning: To attempt an impossible task.

words.urdu: معاملات میں کمی کر کے مصالحت کر لینا
words.meaning: To compromise with the other side.

words.urdu: چہرے پر اداسی دکھائی دینا
words.meaning: To look sad or unhappy.

words.word: To pull the wool over someone's eyes.
words.urdu: آنکھوں پر پٹی باندھنا
words.meaning: To deceive someone.

words.urdu: گڑے مردے اکھاڑنا
words.meaning: To revive old disputes.

words.word: To set a wolf to guard the sheep.
words.urdu: بلی کو دودھ کی رکھوالی بٹھانا
words.meaning: To trust a dangerous person with something valuable.

words.word: To show a lamp to the sun.
words.urdu: آفتاب کو چراغ دکھانا
words.meaning: To teach or help someone who needs none.

words.urdu: دھوبی کا کتا نہ گھر کا نہ گھاٹ کا
words.meaning: To avoid taking sides.

words.urdu: اجازت کے بغیر چھٹی
words.meaning: To leave without permission.

words.word: To take the rough with the smooth.
words.urdu: بعض اوقات ناموافق حالات میں بھی صبر و شکر سے کام لینا پڑتا ہے
words.meaning: To accept both good and bad times.

words.urdu: پانی پر لکھنا
words.meaning: To do something that leaves no trace.

words.urdu: ایک تیر سے دو شکار
words.meaning: Achieving two goals with one action.

words.urdu: بسم اللہ ہی غلط
words.meaning: Doomed from the start.

words.urdu: مکمل کرنا؛ انجام تک پہنچانا؛ عمل میں لانا
words.meaning: Accomplish, bring to a conclusion; put into practice or effect.

words.urdu: کنٹرول، انتظام یا قبضہ سنبھالنا
words.meaning: Assume control, management, or possession of.

words.urdu: سبب بنانا؛ وقوع پذیر کرنا
words.meaning: Cause.

words.urdu: کسی چیز کو پیٹ کر شکل دینا؛ کسی پر سبقت حاصل کرنا/شکست دینا؛ کسی کو دھوکہ دے کر محروم کرنا
words.meaning: Knock into shape by beating; surpass or defeat someone (be chosen over someone); cheat someone of something.

words.urdu: برداشت کرنا؛ رعایت کرنا
words.meaning: Put up with; make allowance for.

words.urdu: انحصار کرنا؛ رجوع کرنا
words.meaning: Rely on; have recourse to.

words.urdu: ناکام ہونا؛ عمل میں نہ آنا
words.meaning: Fail; miscarry.

words.urdu: ذاتی مفاد؛ کسی چیز میں ذاتی حصہ یا دلچسپی
words.meaning: A personal stake in something.

words.urdu: اپنے فائدے کے لیے استعمال کرنا
words.meaning: Use for one's benefit.

words.urdu: بے نتیجہ کوششیں کرنا؛ بے مقصد جدوجہد کرنا
words.meaning: Continue to make futile attempts; fight to no purpose.

words.urdu: کسی کے ساتھ مقابلہ یا جھڑپ میں حصہ لینا
words.meaning: To engage in a tilt or contest.

words.urdu: ناانصافی یا دغا؛ خاص طور پر تشدد سے متعلق کارروائی
words.meaning: Unfair or treacherous action, especially involving violence.

words.urdu: ہمہ وقت مہمان نوازی کرنا؛ ہر وقت مہمانوں کا استقبال کرنا
words.meaning: To entertain friends at all times; to be hospitable.

words.word: Have a finger in the pie.
words.urdu: کسی معاملے میں دخل دینا؛ کسی کام میں دلچسپی یا مداخلت رکھنا
words.meaning: Have an interest in or meddle in something.

words.word: When all is said and done.
words.urdu: آخر کار؛ بہرحال
words.meaning: In the end; nevertheless.

words.urdu: ذاتی مفاد؛ خودغرضانہ مقصد
words.meaning: A selfish aim or motive.

words.urdu: نیا آغاز کرنا؛ برتاؤ یا رویے کو بہتر بنانا
words.meaning: Make a fresh start, change one's conduct or attitude for the better

words.word: Burn the candle at both ends.
words.urdu: طاقت یا وسائل ختم کرنا؛ انتہائی مصروف طرزِ زندگی گزارنا
words.meaning: Exhaust one's energies or resources by leading a hectic life

words.urdu: مشکل میں اکیلا چھوڑ دینا؛ مدد یا تعاون سے انکار کرنا
words.meaning: Desert or leave alone and in trouble, refuse to help or support someone

words.urdu: بات خود واضح ہونا؛ فطری طور پر سمجھاجانا
words.meaning: Be self-evident, a matter of course

words.word: Like a red rag to a bull.
words.urdu: ایسی چیز جو لازماً کسی کو غصہ دلا دے
words.meaning: If something is a red rag to a bull, it is something that will inevitably make somebody angry or cross

words.word: Not a leg to stand on.
words.urdu: کامیابی یا حمایت کا کوئی امکان نہ ہونا؛ دلیل یا سہارا موجود نہ ہونا
words.meaning: With no chance of success

words.urdu: کسی کے زیرِِ کنٹرول یا تسلط میں ہونا
words.meaning: Controlled or dominated by someone

words.urdu: ناکامی یا نقصان کی واضح علامت؛ خطرے کی پیش گوئی
words.meaning: If the writing's on the wall for something, it is doomed to fail; a warning or presentiment of danger

words.urdu: جوانی میں بے پرواہی، بے ضبطی یا جنسی بے راہ روی اختیار کرنا
words.meaning: Behave foolishly, immoderately or promiscuously when young

words.urdu: چھوٹی بات کو بڑھا چڑھا کر ہنگامہ کھڑا کرنا
words.meaning: If someone exaggerates a problem or makes a small problem seem far greater than it really is, then they are making a storm in a teacup

words.urdu: رات دیر تک جاگنا؛ دیر تک جاگ کر رہنا
words.meaning: Stay awake until late at night

words.urdu: حوصلہ شکنی کرنا؛ کسی خیال یا منصوبے کو مایوس کرنا
words.meaning: To discourage, to remove hope, deter

words.urdu: ناقابلِِِ یقین یا دھوکے باز کہانی؛ مبالغہ آمیز جھوٹی بات
words.meaning: An unbelievable tale that is intended to deceive; a tall tale

words.urdu: بدترین اثر یا نقصان کا زیادہ حصہ برداشت کرنا
words.meaning: Put up with the worst of some bad circumstance

words.urdu: کسی (عموماً والدہ یا بیوی) کے مکمل تابع یا محتاج ہونا
words.meaning: Wholly dependent on or controlled by a woman, especially one's mother or wife

words.urdu: ہر ممکن کوشش کرنا؛ بڑے پیمانے پر کوششیں بروئے کار لانا
words.meaning: Exert the utmost effort

words.urdu: اپنی خود تعریف کرنا؛ خود ستائی یا بڑائی کرنا
words.meaning: Boast in a boastful, self-promoting manner; brag about oneself

words.urdu: ماضی کی کامیابیوں پر انحصار کرنا اور مزید محنت سے گریز کرنا
words.meaning: Rely on one's past achievements, especially as a way of avoiding the work needed to advance one's status

words.urdu: قریب یا براہِ راست حدف کے قریب؛ بلواسطہ طور پر قریب
words.meaning: Close enough to go directly to a target

words.urdu: مایوسی، سستی اور بے حوصلگی کا شکار ہونا
words.meaning: Depressed, dull and listless

words.urdu: ایک دوسرے کو غلط سمجھنا یا متضاد اہداف/مقاصد ہونا
words.meaning: When people are at cross purposes, they misunderstand each other or have different or opposing objectives

words.urdu: بہت قریب یا ساتھ ساتھ ہونا؛ نزدیکِِِِِِِ جدا
words.meaning: In close intimacy, side by side (very near one another)

words.urdu: آسان، بے پیچ و خم؛ بلا رکاوٹ پیش رفت
words.meaning: Easy going; straightforward, unobstructed progress. The first few months were difficult, but I think it's plain sailing from here on. Alluding to navigating waters free of hazards, such as rocks or other obstructions, this term was transferred to other activities in the early 1800s.

words.urdu: صاف گوئی سے بات کرنا؛ حقیقت بلا پردہ بیان کرنا
words.meaning: A person who calls a spade a spade is one who speaks frankly and makes little or no attempt to conceal their opinions or to spare the feelings of their audience.

words.urdu: کسی سے ملنے یا مقابلہ کرنے سے گریز کرنا/اجتناب کرنا
words.meaning: Avoid meeting or confronting someone. (Example from Washington Irving: "I have had to fight shy of invitations that would exhaust time and spirits".)

words.urdu: ہو گئی بات پر افسوس کرنا بے فائدہ ہے؛ پچھتاوے میں وقت ضائع کرنا
words.meaning: This idiom means that getting upset after something has gone wrong is pointless; it can't be changed so it should be accepted.

words.urdu: ایک مسئلے کو حل کرنے کے لیے دوسرے کا نقصان کرنا؛ وقتی حل جو نیا مسئلہ پیدا کرے
words.meaning: If you rob Peter to pay Paul, you try to solve one problem, but create another in doing so, often through short-term planning.

words.word: Take the bull by the horns.
words.urdu: مسئلے کا بہادری سے اور براہِ راست سامنا کرنا
words.meaning: Taking a bull by its horns would be the most direct but also the most dangerous way to try to compete with such an animal. When we use the phrase in everyday talk, we mean that the person we are talking about tackles their problems directly and is not worried about any risks involved.

words.urdu: لوگوں کی توجہ یا پسند جیتنے کے لیے سطحی یا دکھاوے کے انداز میں کام کرنا
words.meaning: If someone plays to the gallery, they say or do things that will make them popular at the expense of more important issues.

words.urdu: صلح یا مفاہمت کی پیشکش کرنا؛ مصالحت کا اشارہ دینا
words.meaning: If you hold out or offer an olive branch, you make a gesture to indicate that you want peace.

words.urdu: مختلف معانی: مشکل سے دیکھنا/مشاہدہ کرنا، گزارا کرنا یا نمٹانا، سمجھنا، ثابت کرنا، تحریری طور پر فارم یا دستاویز بنانا
words.meaning: Various senses: Discern or see, especially with difficulty ("I can hardly make out the number on the door"); Manage, get along ("How did you make out with the accountant?"); Understand ("I can't make out what she is trying to say"); Establish or prove ("He made out that he was innocent"); Apply or suggest (often with an infinitive, e.g. "Are you making me out to be a liar?"); Write out, draw up; fill in a written form ("He made out the invoices").

words.urdu: کسی چیز کی حقیقت یا معیار ثابت کرنے والا فیصلہ کن امتحان/آزمائش
words.meaning: An acid test is something that proves whether something is good, effective, etc.

words.urdu: شر پسندی کرنے والا؛ جان بوجھ کر جھگڑا یا ہنگامہ کھڑا کرنے والا شخص
words.meaning: Someone who deliberately stirs up trouble.

words.urdu: خوف یا گھبراہٹ کی حالت؛ یا اداسی و ملال کی کیفیت
words.meaning: In a state of panic or terror. Also in a state of dejection or sadness (two related usages given).

words.urdu: قریباً پیچھے ہونا؛ کسی کا سختی سے پیچھا کرنا/قریب بندوبست رہنا
words.meaning: Immediately behind, in close pursuit. (Also expressed as 'at one's heels'; sometimes intensified as 'hard on someone's heels' or 'hot on someone's heels'.)

words.urdu: کام کرتے ہوئے مر جانا؛ کام میں ہی آخر تک محنت کرتے رہنا
words.meaning: Expire while working; keep working to the end. (Both this phrase and 'die with his boots on' allude to soldiers who died on active duty.)

words.urdu: بالکل مردہ یا قطعی طور پر ختم ہو چکا/بالکل ناکارہ
words.meaning: Totally or assuredly dead; also finished. (PDF notes variants 'dead as a dodo' and 'dead as a herring' but 'dead as a doornail' is the oldest and most common.)

words.urdu: فتح یاب ہونا؛ غالب آنا
words.meaning: Win, prevail. (Example: At auctions the wealthiest bidders usually carry the day.)

words.urdu: اپنا مقام یا وقار کھونا؛ دوسروں کی نظر میں حیثیت کم ہو جانا
words.meaning: If someone is taken down a peg (or a peg or two), they lose status in the eyes of others because of something they have done wrong or badly.

words.urdu: مصیبت میں پڑ جانا
words.meaning: in trouble

words.urdu: اپنے آپ کو سنبھالنا، خود پر قابو پا لینا
words.meaning: Regain one's composure or self-control

words.urdu: محنت کر کے آہستہ آہستہ اعلیٰ عہدے تک پہنچنا
words.meaning: Work one's way to the top

words.urdu: خاص طور پر بااثر یا مشہور لوگوں کے ساتھ مل جل کر وقت گزارنا
words.meaning: If you rub shoulders with people, you meet and spend time with them, especially when they are powerful or famous.

words.word: The thin end of the wedge.
words.urdu: ایسی چھوٹی بات جو بعد میں کسی بڑے اور سنگین مسئلے کی وجہ بن جائے
words.meaning: The thin end of the wedge is something small and seemingly unimportant that will lead to something much bigger and more serious.

words.urdu: عارضی شہرت یا کامیابی جو دیرپا نہ ہو
words.meaning: If something is a flash in the pan, it is very noticeable but doesn't last long.

words.urdu: کوشش جاری رکھنا؛ کسی کو بار بار تنگ کرنا/دباؤ ڈالنا
words.meaning: Persevere or persist at doing something. (Also: Keep at someone — Nag, harass, or annoy someone.)

words.urdu: کسی کی ہر حکم یا خواہش پر فوری عمل کے لیے تیار ہونا
words.meaning: Ready to comply with any wish or command

words.urdu: روایتی طریقے کے برخلاف عمل کرنا
words.meaning: A person who does things in an unconventional manner, especially if their methods are not generally approved of, is said to go against the grain.

words.urdu: کسی فائدے کے لیے قابلِ استعمال چیز
words.meaning: Something that you can use to your advantage is grist for the mill. ('Grist to the mill' is also used.)

words.urdu: احتیاط سے بنے منصوبے برباد کرنا
words.meaning: Spoil carefully laid plans

words.urdu: اپنے ہی بنائے ہوئے پھندے میں خود پھنس جانا
words.meaning: If you are hoist with your own petard, you get into trouble or are caught in a trap that you had set for someone else.

words.word: Live off the fat of the land.
words.urdu: دولت و آسائش میں زندگی بسر کرنا
words.meaning: The best or richest of anything (used of living in great wealth or comfort).

words.word: Have one's cake and eat it too.
words.urdu: ایک ہی وقت میں سب کچھ چاہنا، حتیٰ کہ متضاد خواہشیں بھی
words.meaning: If someone wants to have their cake and eat it too, they want everything their way, especially when their wishes are contradictory.

words.word: Between the devil and the deep blue sea.
words.urdu: دو مشکل یا نقصان دہ انتخابوں کے درمیان پھنس جانا
words.meaning: If you are caught between the devil and the deep blue sea, you are in a dilemma; a difficult choice.

words.urdu: مشکل یا مصیبت میں پڑ جانا
words.meaning: If you get into hot water, you get into trouble.

words.urdu: کسی اختیار رکھنے والے کے سامنے سزا یا سرزنش کے لیے بلایا جانا
words.meaning: Summoned before someone in authority for punishment

words.word: It never rains but it pours.
words.urdu: مصیبتیں اکیلی نہیں آتیں، اکثر ایک ساتھ آ جاتی ہیں
words.meaning: When things go wrong, they go very wrong.

words.word: A miss is as good as a mile.
words.urdu: قریب ناکامی بھی مکمل ناکامی کے برابر ہے
words.meaning: Coming close to success but failing is no better than failing by a lot.

words.urdu: خود کو بڑا ظاہر کرنا یا تکبر دکھانا
words.meaning: Assume a haughty manner, pretend to be better than one is.

words.word: Have the courage of one's convictions.
words.urdu: اپنے عقائد کے مطابق عمل کرنا، اپنی رائے پر ثابت قدم رہنا
words.meaning: Behave according to one's beliefs

words.word: Out of sight, out of mind.
words.urdu: نظروں سے دور، دل سے دور؛ جو چیز دکھائی نہ دے اس کے بارے میں فکر یا یاد نہ رکھنا۔
words.meaning: Used to suggest that someone will not think about or worry about something if it isn't directly visible or available to them.

words.urdu: بند راستے یا بنبستہ صورتِ حال تک پہنچ جانا؛ ایسی صورت جہاں پیش رفت ممکن نہ ہو۔
words.meaning: Reach a passage, situation, or course of action that has no exit or allows no progress; an impasse or blind alley.

words.urdu: غیر متوجہ رہنا؛ کسی کی بات کو نظر انداز کرنا یا نہ سننا۔
words.meaning: To ignore someone; not listen to or heed what is being said.

words.word: Every cloud has a silver lining.
words.urdu: ہر بُری صورت میں بھی کوئی روشنی یا اُمید ہوتی ہے۔
words.meaning: There is an element of hope or a redeeming quality in an otherwise bad situation.

words.urdu: مزاج بدلنا؛ غیر مستحکم ہونا یا بار بار رائے بدلنا۔
words.meaning: To change one's mind frequently; to vacillate or be inconsistent in attitude.

words.word: Let the cat out of the bag.
words.urdu: راز فاش کر دینا؛ خفیہ بات باہر بتا دینا۔
words.meaning: To reveal a secret accidentally or prematurely; give away a secret.

words.word: Put the cart before the horse.
words.urdu: چیزوں کو الٹ ترتیب میں کرنا؛ کام غلط ترتیب سے کرنا۔
words.meaning: To reverse the proper order of things or events; to do things in the wrong sequence.

words.urdu: ایک ہی مشکل میں ہونا؛ ایک جیسی صورتحال کا سامنا کرنا۔
words.meaning: To be in the same predicament or trouble as someone else.

words.urdu: آخری کارکردگی یا انجام؛ آخری پیش کاری۔
words.meaning: A final accomplishment or performance; one's last work.

words.urdu: پیچھے ہٹ جانا؛ کسی صورت حال یا معاہدے سے دستبردار ہو جانا۔
words.meaning: To withdraw from a situation or agreement; to retreat or break an engagement.

words.urdu: زور سے ٹکرانا یا جا ٹکرانا؛ زور سے مارنا یا کسی بات کو جبراً سمجھانا/منوانا۔
words.meaning: Crash noisily into or collide with; also, strike heavily so as to drive in, and figuratively, to try hard to persuade or impress.

words.urdu: کچھ غلط ہونے کا شک محسوس کرنا؛ دھوکہ ہونے کا اندازہ لگانا۔
words.meaning: To sense instinctively that something is wrong or that someone is being dishonest.

words.urdu: خود کو نقصان پہنچانا؛ خطرناک کام کرنے کے سبب نقصان اٹھانا۔
words.meaning: To harm oneself, especially by getting involved in a risky or unfortunate enterprise.

words.urdu: باطل و منسوخ؛ غیر مؤثر یا قانونی طور پر غلط۔
words.meaning: Cancelled or invalid; legally ineffective.

words.urdu: پِیچھا کر پکڑنا/پہنچ جانا؛ کسی چیز میں مگن ہو جانا؛ پیچھے رہ جانے والے امور کو پورا یا تازہ کرنا۔
words.meaning: Have several senses: to overtake; to come from behind and reach; to become involved with or enthralled by; and (catch up on/with) to bring up to date.

words.urdu: تصدیق کرنا یا ثبوت دینا؛ بات کی تائید کرنا۔
words.meaning: To back up or confirm; to show something to be true.

words.urdu: آگے منتقل کرنا یا برقرار رکھنا؛ کسی چیز کو بعد کی مدت کے لیے رکھنا یا کیفیت کا برقرار رہنا۔
words.meaning: To keep something (often merchandise) for a subsequent period; also, to persist from one time or situation to another.

words.urdu: واقع ہونا/پیش آنا؛ خود کو ثابت کرنا یا نتیجہ اخذ کرنا؛ کامیاب ہونا۔
words.meaning: To happen or occur; to acquit oneself or reach an outcome (usually with a modifier); and to succeed (e.g., an event coming off successfully).

words.urdu: پیچھے ہٹ جانا؛ پسپائی اختیار کرنا یا پیچھے ہونا۔
words.meaning: To give ground or retreat; to recede.

words.urdu: پتہ لگانا، حل کرنا یا سمجھ جانا
words.meaning: Discover or determine; (also) solve or decipher; begin to comprehend or come to understand someone or something

words.urdu: کسی تکلیف یا ناگوار چیز کے عادی ہو جانا
words.meaning: Get used to or accustom oneself to something that is painful, annoying, or unpleasant

words.urdu: داخل کرنا یا لگانا؛ وقوع پذیر ہونا/ظاہر ہونا؛ (ہوا یا پانی کے بارے میں) کنارے کی طرف بڑھنا
words.meaning: Insert or put in; begin to happen or become apparent; (also) move toward the shore, said of wind or water

words.urdu: ڈھانپنا/محفوظ کرنا؛ (خاص طور پر جرم کو) چھپانا
words.meaning: Wrap up or enfold in order to protect; (also) conceal something, especially a crime

words.urdu: مسئلے حل کرنا یا اختلافات طے کرنا
words.meaning: Work out, resolve, settle

words.urdu: آخری ناامیدانہ کوشش
words.meaning: A desperate final attempt

words.urdu: مکمل اور توانائی بخش کھانا
words.meaning: A substantial or complete meal

words.urdu: عوامی کمپنی بننا (شیئر جاری کرنا)
words.meaning: Become a publicly held company (issue ownership shares as stock)

words.urdu: بے قابو یا پرجوش انداز میں برتاؤ کرنا
words.meaning: Behave in a frenzied, out-of-control, or unrestrained manner

words.urdu: دکان کے پچھلے کمرے میں پوکر کھیلنے اور سگریٹ پینے والا آدمی/افراد
words.meaning: Men who play poker and smoke in a room at the back of the store (colloquial usage)

words.urdu: بل ادا کرنا، خرچ برداشت کرنا
words.meaning: Pay the bill for everybody; settle the accounts

words.urdu: دوسروں کے لیے معیار یا رفتار مقرر کرنا
words.meaning: Establish a standard for others to follow

words.urdu: کبھی کبھار
words.meaning: Occasionally, sometimes

words.urdu: توجہ کا مرکز بن جانا، سب سے زیادہ متاثر کن ہونا
words.meaning: Be the center of attention (outshine others)

words.urdu: انسانی دماغ
words.meaning: The human brain (i.e., brain tissue)

words.urdu: رومانوی طور پر کسی کا پیچھا کرنا/کوشش کرنا
words.meaning: Pursue someone romantically

words.urdu: جھوٹ بولنا یا مبالغہ آرائی کرنا
words.meaning: Lie or exaggerate

words.urdu: کسی کو اجتماعی طور پر نظر انداز کرنا/بائیکاٹ کرنا
words.meaning: Ostracize, or systematically ignore someone

words.urdu: زندگی صرف خود غرضی اور تفریح و راحت تک محدود نہیں ہوتی
words.meaning: (Used in 'life is not all beer and skittles') Not solely about self-indulgence and pleasure

words.urdu: ایسا خفیہ راز جو معلوم ہونے پر نقصان پہنچا سکتا ہو
words.meaning: A secret in your past which could damage you if it became known

words.urdu: کسی چیز کے حصول میں مدد دینا؛ سبب بننا
words.meaning: to help to bring about Your cooperation will make for the success of our project This class will make for the Auditorium now.

words.urdu: مفید اور وفادار خدمت؛ سخت محنت
words.meaning: Efficient, useful or loyal service; arduous work Tipu sultan rendered yeoman service for the the Islam

words.word: Discretion is the better part of valour.
words.urdu: یہ کہاوت ظاہر کرتی ہے کہ عمل کرنے سے پہلے محتاط رہنا اور سوچنا بہادری اور خطرہ مول لینے سے بہتر ہے۔
words.meaning: something that you say which means that it is better to be careful and think before you act than it is to be brave and take risks She decided not to voice her opposition to the Chairman's remarks. Perhaps discretion was the better part of valour

words.urdu: خطرناک مرحلے سے نکل جانا؛ مشکلات سے باہر ہونا
words.meaning: past a critical phase; out of the unknown. When the patient got out of the woods, everyone relaxed. THE CSS POINT I can give you a better prediction for your future health when you are out of the woods.

words.urdu: فیصلہ کن ووٹ
words.meaning: decisive vote The speaker used his casting vote in the favour of proposition

words.urdu: حقارت سے دیکھنا
words.meaning: think nothing of, be contemptuous of Do not look down upon the poor

words.urdu: اپنے کہے ہوئے الفاظ واپس لینا؛ اپنی غلطی کا اعتراف کرنا
words.meaning: To eat one's words means to admit that you are or were mistaken, especially after a strong or public expression of opinion. Sentence: I told everyone to invest in that company, and now it's bankrupt – I'll have to eat my words.

words.urdu: کسی چیز کو رکھ کر دوسروں کو اسے استعمال کرنے سے روکنا حالانکہ اسے خود ضرورت نہ ہو
words.meaning: Someone who keeps something that they do not really want in order to prevent anyone else from having it. Sentence: Stop being such a dog in the manger and let your brother ride your bike if you're not using it.

words.urdu: بہت کم فرق سے بچ جانا؛ خطرے سے قریبی بچاؤ
words.meaning: A narrow escape. Sentence: Wow, that was a close shave. I thought the guard would spot us.

words.urdu: زبان سے نکلا ایسا غلط لفظ جو دبے ہوئے خیالات یا جذبات ظاہر کرے
words.meaning: A verbal mistake that is thought to reveal a repressed belief, thought, or emotion.

words.urdu: ایک پیچیدہ اور حل مشکل مسئلہ
words.meaning: A Difficult Problem Sentence: Homelessness in the inner cities has become a real Gordian knot.

words.urdu: کسی بڑے نظام کا معمولی حصہ
words.meaning: One part of a large system or organization. Sentence: He was just a small cog in the large wheel of organised crime.

words.urdu: ایک امیر، اکثر عمر رسیدہ مرد جو رشتے یا سنگت کے بدلے نوجوان کو قیمتی تحائف دیتا ہے
words.meaning: A wealthy, usually older man who gives expensive gifts to a young person in return for sexual favors or companionship.

words.urdu: محفل کا مزہ خراب کرنے والا شخص
words.meaning: Someone who does or says something that stops other people from enjoying themselves. Sentence: I don't want to be a wet blanket, but you really must play your music more quietly or you'll disturb the people next door.

words.urdu: خیالی اور بے مقصد خوابوں میں کھو جانا
words.meaning: To engage in fanciful daydreaming.

words.urdu: شدید عذاب یا ظلم و ستم کا شکار ہونا
words.meaning: Subjected to actual torture with a toothed instrument, or to great affliction or oppression.

words.urdu: کوئی تسلی یا آرام نہیں؛ تسلی دینے والی بات نہیں
words.meaning: No comfort or consolation at all. Sentence: She knows there are others worse off than her, but that's cold comfort.

words.urdu: وہ عورت جو امیروں کے ساتھ تعلق قائم کر کے پیسے حاصل کرتی ہے
words.meaning: A woman who has relationships with rich men so that they will give her money. Sentence: I'm not saying she's a gold digger, but how come all her boyfriends have been rich?

words.urdu: خدا کے احکام کی اطاعت میں زندگی گزارنا اور اس کے ساتھ تعلق رکھنا
words.meaning: To live in obedience to his commands, and have communion with him.

words.urdu: رسک یا غیر یقینی حالت میں ہونا؛ خطرے میں ہونا
words.meaning: In an uncertain condition. Sentence: My brother was already on thin ice with the coach when he injured his knee.

words.urdu: ایک عجیب و غریب شخص
words.meaning: A strange person.

words.urdu: انسانی ہمدردی اور فطری مہربانی
words.meaning: Natural kindness and sympathy shown to others.

words.urdu: تقریباً درست اندازہ لگانے کا طریقہ/عام قاعدہ
words.meaning: A way of calculating something which is not exact but which will help you to be correct enough.

words.urdu: بالکل مکمل/پوری طرح
words.meaning: Complete; thoroughgoing

words.word: To air one's dirty linen in public.
words.urdu: ذاتی یا شرمندہ کن باتیں کھلے عام بیان کرنا
words.meaning: To discuss private or embarrassing matters in public, especially when quarreling.

words.urdu: بہت زیادہ قیمت ادا کرنا
words.meaning: To pay too much for something.

words.urdu: عزت یا وقار کھونا
words.meaning: To lose status; to become less respectable.

words.urdu: کسی کے لیے نیک خواہشات رکھنا/اچھی قسمت کی دعا کرنا
words.meaning: To wish for luck for someone or something.

words.urdu: طنزیہ یا مزاحیہ انداز میں کہنا؛ حالانکہ سنجیدہ معلوم ہو
words.meaning: If you say something tongue in cheek, what you have said is a joke, although it might seem to be serious.

words.urdu: بے علم ہو کر بڑے انداز میں بات کرنا/غیر مستند باتیں کہنا
words.meaning: To be talking about a subject as if you know a lot about it when in fact you know very little.

words.urdu: جھجک یا ہچکچاہٹ سے بات ٹالنا/براہِ راست نہ کہنا
words.meaning: To pause a lot and avoid saying something directly.

words.word: Let the grass grow under one's feet.
words.urdu: تاخیر کرنا/وقت ضائع کرنا
words.meaning: To waste time by delaying doing something.

words.urdu: چھوٹی بچت کے چکر میں بڑا نقصان کرنا
words.meaning: Unwise because doing something small now would prevent much more trouble later.

words.urdu: پیسے کی خواہش/لالچ؛ رشوت لینے کا شوق
words.meaning: A desire for money, greed; also, wanting a bribe.

words.urdu: لذت بھرا، خوشگوار طریقۂ زندگی
words.meaning: A pleasurable way of life

words.urdu: گرنے/پھسلنے کو روک دینا
words.meaning: Interrupt a tumble or descent

words.urdu: کسی چیز یا مسئلے سے اپنی ذمہ داری ختم کر دینا
words.meaning: To absolve oneself of responsibility or future blame for; to refuse to have any further involvement with

words.urdu: کسی چیز کو ہم آہنگ یا مطابقت میں لانا؛ قبول کر لینا
words.meaning: To bring something into harmony, accord, or balance with something.

words.urdu: کسی چیز کے خلاف کام کرنا/رکاوٹ بننا
words.meaning: To work against something.

words.urdu: کسی چیز سے باخبر/واقف ہونا
words.meaning: Fully informed; conscious
